base.title: Minga Hub
intro: Mingaworks is an digital studio working at the intersection of ecology, design, and technology.
We replace messy, fragile systems with resilient digital tools that bridge the gap between complex technology and practical, human-scale impact.

values.title: Radical Pragmatism
values.desc: We choose the simplest tool that solves the problem. No over-engineering; just robust, maintainable solutions.

values.title: Holistic Ownership
values.desc: We don't just ship features; we understand product reality. We build systems we are proud to stand behind.

values.title: Open Sovereignty
values.desc: Data belongs to the community. We favor open-source, decentralized, and transparent architectures.

base.vision: A world where local communities and nomadic builders are empowered by sovereign digital tools, moving away from extractive platforms toward collaborative, self-hosted ecosystems.

team.name: Mali Bulut
team.bio: Engineer and product builder turning ambiguous problems into testable solutions. Admires simplicity; builds for longevity.

team.name: Gamze Kurt
team.bio: Designer and strategist focused on visual clarity and systemic coherence. Leads design direction, storytelling, and user experience.

collaborate.title: Work with us
